summary: Suwannee County lookout; the Eastern US Lookouts list says it was sold at auction in 2008. Two USGS atmosphere sites share its spot. Standing status unknown.

events.note: The list says the tower was sold at auction for approximately $1000. It does not name the buyer or any later fate.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: USGS records at the same coordinates use both Rocky Hill Fire Tower and Rock Hill Fire Tower. The Walton County Rock Hill (us-fl-rock-hill) is a separate place.

sources.title: Rock Hill Fire Tower, Bulk precipitation collector

notes_for_editor: Story is below the 120-word floor. The 2008 sale and $1000 price come only from the Eastern US Lookouts index entry, not a primary record. The USGS names put atmosphere sites on the spot, but the USGS pages are undated and do not say whether a tower stands. The record coordinates (30.1649, -82.8886) are close to the USGS coordinates (30.16439, -82.88818). The record's agency is null and nothing here supports one. Confidence low.
